name: Beaver Lake Park (Alpena County Park)
evidence: Alpena Co campground map (DocumentCenter/View/278): sites 1-4 and 57-58 front the lake by the boat launch; satellite at 44.9305,-83.7945: west-row RVs ~25 m from the shore across open lawn with docks, no road or treeline; old pin was in woods ~150 m SE

name: Camp Petosega
evidence: satellite at 45.3912,-84.7402: loops all east of the park road, westernmost pads ~190 m from Pickerel Lake behind forest, the road and the day-use beach/parking; cabins only nearer the shore

name: Chalk Hills Campground
evidence: old pin was the W-2/Chalk Hill Rd junction by the dam; re-pinned to the OSM campground polygon (way 1065873213) just N; satellite: canopy, the polygon's W edge ~100 m from the flowage behind continuous forest and a powerline track, ~26 m above the water (DEM 250 vs 224); operator: 'Riverview - not riverfront', river by trail

name: Caseville County Park
evidence: satellite at 43.9478,-83.2742 and 43.9462,-83.2785: nearest RV rows ~150-200 m from Saginaw Bay, across dune grass, a beach walkway and a public day-use beach with pavilion and parking lot; open sightline, so lakeview; county 'Lakefront' sites don't meet the on-water bound

name: Hancock Recreation Area Campground
evidence: satellite at 47.1326,-88.6200: RV pads on the lake side of the shore loop road, ~12-17 m from Portage Lake behind only a thin brush fringe; matches the city's BookMySites waterfront sites 47, 49-55

name: John Gurney Park
evidence: satellite at 43.7064,-86.3593: nearest RV pads ~55 m from Hart Lake behind a continuous wooded bank (dense treeline, no sightline); beach and launch are separate day-use areas

name: O.B. Fuller Park and Campground
evidence: old pin was the M-35 Bark River bridge; re-pinned to the loop ~700 m SSE (OSM Fuller County Park); satellite at 45.5704,-87.2490: pads east of the loop road ~20-30 m from Lake Michigan across open grass and the park's own narrow sand beach; matches Campspot's 7 'Lake Front' sites
